info.name: Pawfront — Pet Parent API
info.description:
Postman collection for the Pawfront pet-parent host (Pawfront.PetParentApi). All endpoints are under /api/v1 and require a Firebase ID token from the pet-parent Firebase project (`littersoftpetparent`) — passed as `Authorization: Bearer {{idToken}}`.

**Setup**
1. Set `baseUrl` (default `https://localhost:7216`).
2. Get a pet-parent Firebase ID token (see CLAUDE.md `Get a fresh Firebase ID token`) and set `idToken`.
3. Run the folders top-to-bottom — they are ordered chronologically (onboarding → profile → pets → discovery → bookings → events). Most requests carry a **test script that auto-captures ids** (`petParentId`, `petId`, `parentMobileOtpId`, `providerId`, `serviceId`, `bookingId`, `eventId`, `eventBookingId`, `petParentPhotoId`) into collection variables, so you rarely need to paste a GUID by hand.

**Notes**
- Response envelope is `{ success: bool, data: T | null, error: { code, message } | null }`.
- The `/pet-parents/{petParentId}/*` and `/pets/{petId}/*` routes are ownership-filtered: the caller's PetParentId is derived from the JWT, so the route id must be your own.
- Provider **discovery / search / booking** only return data if a provider has been registered via the provider host (`Pawfront.Api`). Run that collection first to seed a provider, or paste a known `providerId` / `serviceId`.
- Image-upload requests use multipart with field name `file` — attach a local file before sending.
- `serviceId` is the booked service. Searches return `serviceId` per hit; their test scripts capture the first one.

variable.description: Captured by the provider searches / discovery. Or paste one from the provider host.
Captured by the provider searches (first hit's serviceId).
PetGroomer menu code (one of the 18 canonical codes).
Captured by GET /events (first hit) and POST /pet-parents/{petParentId}/events.
Set to any URL returned by an upload endpoint to test POST /blob-images.

request.description: Static reference vocabularies for mobile pickers → { animals: [{code, displayName}], behaviours: [{code, displayName}] }. Derived from the Pawfront.Domain.Vocabularies enums (Animal/Behaviour). Not ownership-filtered — needed during onboarding, before a profile exists.
Upserts Parent.ParentAuthIdentities + (optional) device token from the JWT. All body fields optional. Call this FIRST after sign-in.

body.raw:
{
  "firstName": "Jane",
  "lastName": "Doe",
  "gender": "Female",
  "mobileCountryCode": "+41",
  "mobileNumber": "791234567",
  "dateOfBirth": "1990-05-12",
  "addressLine": "Bahnhofstrasse 1",
  "latitude": 47.3769,
  "longitude": 8.5417,
  "zipCode": "8001",
  "city": "Zurich",
  "description": "Loving pet parent of one happy dog."
}

request.description: Creates Parent.PetParents and links to the auth identity (resolved from JWT sub/user_id — NOT from the body). `description` ("About Me") is OPTIONAL — omit or send blank to store none. `gender` accepts Male / Female / Others / Non Binary (also NonBinary / Other / PreferNotToSay); spacing, hyphens and casing are ignored, and "Others" is stored as "Other". One account per mobile number — a number already registered to another parent is rejected with 409 MobileNumberAlreadyExists (checked explicitly in the sproc, with the UNIQUE index as the race-safe backstop). Captures `petParentId`. 404 ParentAuthIdentityNotFound if `firebase-auth` was never called; 400 UnsupportedGender.

Resolves the caller's Firebase uid → { parentAuthIdentityId, petParentId?, firebaseUserId, email, isEmailVerified, displayName, signUpStatus, hasProfile, mobileVerifiedAtUtc? }. Used by mobile after reinstall to recover the PetParentId. Re-captures `petParentId` if a profile exists.

item.name: 1b. Device Tokens
item.description: An FCM token is not stable (reinstall, cleared app data, restore, Firebase's own rotation) and the sign-in flow only runs at sign in — call POST /device-tokens on every app launch AND from Firebase's onTokenRefresh callback, or a rotated token silently stops receiving notifications. Owner is resolved from the JWT (sub/user_id), never the body.

request.description: Registers/refreshes the caller's FCM token. NOT ownership-filtered — the token binds to the auth identity, which exists before the profile does (a parent mid-onboarding can register; PetParentId is back-filled by profile completion). Supplying `deviceId` retires every OTHER active token for that physical device (including another account's), so a reinstall retires the old token immediately; omit it and nothing is retired. `devicePlatform` is Android|iOS case-insensitive, optional. Returns { deviceTokenId, ownerId (null pre-profile), deviceId, devicePlatform, isActive, retiredTokenCount, lastSeenAtUtc, createdAtUtc, updatedAtUtc } — the FCM token itself is deliberately NOT echoed back. 404 ParentAuthIdentityNotFound when the caller hasn't hit firebase-auth yet.

Sign-out counterpart — flips IsActive = 0, scoped to the caller's own auth identity via the JWT. The row is kept, not deleted (FcmToken is UNIQUE), so signing back in reactivates it in place. POST rather than DELETE: minimal APIs refuse an inferred body on DELETE, and the token would otherwise have to go in the URL. 404 DeviceTokenNotFound — unknown and not-yours are the same case, by design.
Full profile read-back (name, gender, email + isEmailVerified, mobile, DOB, address, lat/lng, zip, city, description, profilePhotoUrl, mobileVerifiedAtUtc, timestamps). 404 PetParentNotFound.

Edits the basic-profile subset. `description` is optional; `gender` accepts Male / Female / Others / Non Binary (case- and spacing-insensitive). NOT editable here: mobile number (re-verify via OTP), latitude/longitude, profile photo (own endpoint). Returns the full read-back shape. 404 PetParentNotFound; 409 ParentAccountDeleted; 400 UnsupportedGender / InvalidRequest.

"Delete account" = ANONYMISE + permanently DISABLE, NOT a row delete. Scrubs the personal fields (name → "Deleted User", mobile/address/DOB replaced, about + profile photo cleared), severs the Firebase login (freeing the real uid AND mobile number for a fresh sign-up), anonymises the parent's pets in place (name → "Deleted Pet"), and deletes device tokens, OTPs, the identity document and every photo gallery.

RETAINED: bookings, night-stay bookings, organised events, event tickets and the payment ledger — that history belongs to the PROVIDER too.

**409 PendingJobsExist (2026-08-05)** when the parent still has UNFINISHED jobs — any booking of either kind in a non-terminal status (a request the provider hasn't answered, a confirmed job still to come, one underway, or one with an open modification proposal). Nothing is scrubbed in that case; the response keeps the standard envelope with the list in `data`: { petParentId, pendingJobs: [{ bookingId, bookingType (SingleDay|NightStay), jobId, providerId, providerName, providerProfilePhotoUrl, serviceCategory, subCategory, status, serviceDate, checkOutDate, startTime, endTime, petName, serviceId, serviceItemCode, price: { pricePerUnit, priceUnit, totalAmount, pawfrontFee, feePercentage } }] }, soonest first. No force override — the check runs inside the same transaction that already holds a lock on the parent row, so a booking landing at the same instant serialises rather than slipping past.

Idempotent (when it succeeds). Returns { petParentId, deletedAtUtc, wasAlreadyDeleted, anonymisedPetCount, retainedBookingCount, retainedNightStayBookingCount, retainedEventCount, retainedPaymentCount }. 404 PetParentNotFound.

After this runs the caller's token no longer resolves, so every /pet-parents/* route answers 403 ParentProfileNotCompleted.
multipart/form-data — attach a `file` (≤3 MB, JPEG/PNG/WebP). 400 InvalidFile/ImageTooLarge/UnsupportedImageFormat; 404 PetParentNotFound.
General pet-parent photo gallery. One row per upload — call N times for N photos. Captures `petParentPhotoId`. ≤3 MB, JPEG/PNG/WebP. 404 PetParentNotFound.
Lists the parent's gallery photos, oldest-first ([] when none).
Removes one gallery photo (scoped by PetParentId + PhotoId) + best-effort blob delete. 404 PetParentPhotoNotFound.
multipart/form-data. file ≤3 MB, JPEG/PNG/WebP; identityType ∈ {Passport, DriverLicense, NationalId, ResidencePermit}. One identity per parent — re-uploading replaces.

Reads the parent's single identity row with full details + the document blob URL: { parentIdentityId, petParentId, identityType, identityPhotoUrl, createdAtUtc, updatedAtUtc }. Fetch the document bytes by POSTing identityPhotoUrl to /blob-images. 404 ParentIdentityNotFound when none on file.
Removes the parent's single identity row + best-effort blob delete. 404 ParentIdentityNotFound.
Returns { basicInfo, profilePhoto, pets, petMedicalInfo, identity, verification, isFullyOnboarded }.
Generates a 6-digit OTP (10-min expiry, NoOp sender today). Captures `parentMobileOtpId`. Returns { parentMobileOtpId, mobileCountryCode, mobileNumber, dateSentUtc, expiresAtUtc }.
Always 200; client branches on { isValidated, validationStatus: Validated|Invalid|Expired|Pending }. (The dev OTP is not 123456 — read it from the API logs / sender, or replace here.)
Captures `petId`. petType ∈ {Dog, Cat, Hamster, GuineaPig}; gender ∈ {Male, Female}; weight DECIMAL(5,2) > 0; microchipId globally UNIQUE (409 MicrochipIdAlreadyExists — change it if it collides).

Returns all pets with embedded photo gallery (oldest-first) and nextConsultations [{ type: Groomer|Vet|Trainer, nextConsultation }] — written by providers via the booking-complete flow. Empty array if none — list semantics, no 404.

Single pet profile — full basic-info + medical-info snapshot (incl. vaccinationType, vaccinationDose, prescription) + embedded photo gallery (oldest-first) + nextConsultations [{ type: Groomer|Vet|Trainer, nextConsultation }], same shape as the list endpoint. Ownership-filtered: 404 PetNotFound (unknown pet), 403 Forbidden (someone else's pet).
Edits the basic-info subset only — medical-info untouched. Same shape as AddPet.

body.raw:
{
  "vaccinationStatus": "Vaccinated",
  "sterilizationStatus": "Sterilized",
  "medicalHistory": "Mild seasonal allergies.",
  "temperament": "Friendly",
  "vaccinationType": "Rabies",
  "vaccinationDose": "Booster",
  "prescription": "Antihistamine 5mg daily during pollen season."
}

request.description: vaccinationStatus ∈ {Vaccinated, NotVaccinated}; sterilizationStatus ∈ {Sterilized, Intact}; temperament ∈ {Anxious, Friendly, Aggressive} but OPTIONAL (omit/empty → null); medicalHistory, vaccinationType, vaccinationDose, and prescription are optional free text (omit/empty → null — note this PATCH overwrites ALL medical fields, so resend values you want to keep). Only vaccination + sterilization gate onboarding completeness. The extras are also surfaced on the booking-detail petDetails section.

multipart/form-data — attach a `file` (≤3 MB, JPEG/PNG/WebP). Sets the pet's SINGLE primary/profile photo (distinct from the gallery below) — stored on Parent.Pets.ProfilePhotoUrl and surfaced as `profilePhotoUrl` on every pet read. Returns { petId, profilePhotoUrl, updatedAtUtc }. Ownership-filtered. 404 PetNotFound; 400 InvalidFile / ImageTooLarge / UnsupportedImageFormat.
multipart/form-data — attach a `file` (≤3 MB, JPEG/PNG/WebP). One row per upload; call N times for N photos. Captures `petPhotoId`.

**SOFT-deletes the pet (2026-08-05)** — an ANONYMISE + HIDE, not a row delete, the same shape as the account deletes. The row survives on purpose: Booking.Bookings.PetId references it and the provider's booking detail resolves petDetails through that join, so a real delete would silently erase the pet from the PROVIDER's record of a job they actually performed. What goes: name → "Deleted Pet", microchipId → NULL (frees the chip for re-registration), profile photo, description and the free-text medical fields, plus the photo gallery and next-consultation rows outright. What stays: type, breed, gender, DOB, weight and the vaccination/sterilization/temperament statuses — the facts that keep a past booking meaningful. IsDeleted = 1 then hides the pet everywhere that matters (every /pets/{petId}/* route 404s, it drops out of GET /pet-parents/{id}/pets, onboarding-status, discovery/search, and both booking creates) — booking READS deliberately do NOT filter on it.

**409 PendingJobsExist (2026-08-09)** when THIS PET still has unfinished jobs — any booking of either kind naming it in a non-terminal status. Nothing is scrubbed; the response keeps the standard envelope with { petId, pendingJobs: [...] } in `data`, the identical job shape the account delete returns above. No force override.

Returns { petId, petParentId, deletedAtUtc, wasAlreadyDeleted }. Ownership-filtered → 404 PetNotFound for unknown pet, 403 Forbidden for someone else's pet. A second DELETE 404s (not wasAlreadyDeleted: true) because the ownership filter already can't find a live pet — the sproc's idempotency mainly protects against races, not direct repeat calls.

Removes one photo from a pet's gallery (scoped by petId + photoId) + best-effort blob delete. Ownership-filtered. Returns { petPhotoId, petId, photoUrl, deletedAtUtc }. 404 PetPhotoNotFound; 403 Forbidden / 404 PetNotFound on the pet.

item.name: 5. Provider Discovery & Search
item.description: Parent-facing browse + per-service booking search. These return data only if a provider has been registered via the provider host. `petId` (optional) is ownership-enforced and its PetType becomes the animal filter. Each search test script captures the first hit's `providerId` + `serviceId` for the booking + slots folders below. Each per-service search hit also carries `imageUrl` — the service image the provider uploaded for that offering (null when unset).

query.description: Optional. Must be your pet; its PetType becomes the animal filter.
PetSitter | PetGroomer | PetTrainer | Vet (PetAdoptionAndSale is not a valid filter value)
date + startTime + endTime travel as a trio (full free-slot check).
case-insensitive exact match
ParentsPlace | ProvidersPlace
1..200, default 50

request.description: Slim summary cards. ALL filters optional + combinable. Captures the first hit's `providerId`. NOTE: the old `?serviceCategory=` / `?animals=` params were REMOVED — use `?providerType=` and `?petId=`.

query.description: date+startTime+endTime trio; FULL window must be bookable.

request.description: PetSitter/DayCare search. Charges = PricePerHour. Captures first hit's `providerId` + `serviceId`.

query.description: startDate+pickupDate pair; pickupDate is checkout (not a stayed night); span ≤ 30 nights.

request.description: PetSitter/NightStay search. Every night from startDate..pickupDate-1 must have free capacity. Charges = PricePerHour.

query.description: One of the 18 canonical codes; when set, charges = that item's price.

request.description: PetGroomer/GroomingSession search. With serviceItemCode → only providers offering that ACTIVE item; charges = item price (PerService). Without → any groomer with ≥1 active item; charges null.
Vet/VetAppointment search. date → any free appointment slot that day. Charges = PricePerAppointment (PerAppointment).

query.description: Optional. Must be your pet; its PetType becomes the animal filter.
Optional. date → any free slot of the session's duration that day.
ParentsPlace | ProvidersPlace

request.description: PetTrainer/TrainingSession search. A training session is a single fixed-duration booking (like a vet appointment): date → any free slot of the session's duration that day. Charges = PricePerSession (PerSession). Each hit carries imageUrl (the offering's service image).

Parent-facing provider profile: registration, category-specific offering, workingHours (7 days), timeOff, minimumHoursBeforeCancellation (null|24|48|72|96), acceptedPaymentMethods (["Cash"|"Digital"], [] when unset), `completedBookings` (bookings explicitly COMPLETED or already served — window ended, not cancelled/no-show/expired — across all the provider's services, spanning both single-day and multi-night boarding stays; same figure as the search cards), top-level `description` (the freelancer's about-you text; null for business sub-categories) + `servicesDescription` (the business branch's description; null for freelancers), `profilePhotoUrl` (the provider's profile/business image; null when none), `galleryImages` ([] the provider's gallery photos), top-level `email` + `mobileCountryCode` + `mobileNumber` (a business reports the contact it registered; a FREELANCER registers none, so theirs falls back to their account e-mail + verified mobile — same fallback when a business left the optional telephone blank), `reviewSummary` (2026-08-08; { reviewCount, averageRating, fiveStar..oneStar } over EVERY review the provider has received — averageRating is null, not 0.0, when nobody has reviewed), and `reviews` (the newest 10, a PREVIEW for this screen — page through the full list with GET /providers/{providerId}/reviews below). 404 ProviderNotRegistered.

The provider's day for ONE service, laid out as a contiguous timeline of blocks so the parent can see the shape of the day and pick a slot — needs NO duration (unlike /availability/slots), which is the point: browse first, then ask for exact slots once you know what you want. Returns { providerId, serviceId, date, serviceCategory, subCategory, serviceType, capacity, isOpen, isClosedForDay, openingTime, closingTime, entries: [{ startTime, endTime, entryType (Free|Booked|Break|Closed), status, jobId, bookingId, remainingCapacity, isBookable }] }. `entries` never overlaps and merges neighbours that read alike (an untouched morning is ONE block). **Other parents' jobs are masked** — `status`/`jobId`/`bookingId` are only real for a booking belonging to the caller (resolved from the JWT); anyone else's reads `status: "BOOKED"` with null ids. NightStay collapses to a single whole-day block (openingTime/closingTime null). 400 InvalidServiceId / OfferingNotConfigured / InvalidRequest; 404 ServiceNotRegistered. Not ownership-filtered — it's someone else's calendar, same posture as the rest of /providers/*.

The reviews other parents have left for this provider — what a parent reads before booking. Returns { providerId, summary { reviewCount, averageRating, fiveStar..oneStar }, reviews: [{ bookingReviewId, bookingType, bookingId, jobId, petParentId, parentName, parentPhotoUrl, rating, comment, photoUrls, createdAtUtc, updatedAtUtc }], skip, take, hasMore }. `summary` is WHOLE-POPULATION, not page-scoped — it's the header's "4.6 (23)" and must not shift as the reader pages; averageRating is null (not 0.0) when nobody has reviewed. `sortBy` is Date|Rating, `sortDirection` Asc|Desc, both with a bookingReviewId tie-break. `take` caps at 20. parentName/photo are joined LIVE, so a deleted account reads "Deleted User". NOT ownership-filtered — someone else's public profile data. 400 InvalidRequest on an unknown sortBy/sortDirection.

query.description: PetSitter / PetTrainer / Vet
default 30

request.description: Free-slot query for PetSitter DayCare / PetTrainer / Vet (use durationHours). Closures, capacity, and overlapping confirmed bookings are subtracted per-service. Each returned slot carries `remainingCapacity`; fully-booked windows are returned with `remainingCapacity: 0` so the client can render them as unavailable.

query.description: A NightStay ServiceId
First night
Last night (inclusive, max 31 nights; defaults to date)

request.description: NightStay is DATE-granular: capacity is per night, not per time window. The response fills `nights` (one entry per night: `{ date, activeBookings, remainingCapacity, isClosed, isAvailable }`) and leaves `slots` empty; `durationHours`/`granularityMinutes` are ignored. A night is unavailable when a full-day closure covers it or active stays (CheckInDate <= night < CheckOutDate) have used every capacity unit.

query.description: One of the 18 canonical PetGroomer codes

request.description: PetGroomer uses serviceItemCode — duration resolved server-side from the menu item. Errors: 400 InvalidServiceId / ServiceItemCodeRequired / ServiceItemNotOffered / InvalidBookingDuration / OfferingNotConfigured; 409 ServiceItemInactive; 404 ServiceNotRegistered.

item.name: 6. Service Bookings (parent-initiated)
item.description: Parent 'book now' against a discovered service. Needs `petId` (your pet) + `serviceId` (from a search). bookingDate / startTime / endTime must fall inside the provider's working hours for the booked service — adjust to a free slot returned by the slots endpoint.

body.raw:
{
  "petId": "{{petId}}",
  "serviceId": "{{serviceId}}",
  "bookingDate": "2026-07-15",
  "startTime": "10:00:00",
  "endTime": "12:00:00",
  "serviceItemCode": null,
  "jobNotes": "Gate code is 1234; Bruno is shy around strangers.",
  "locationType": "ProviderLocation"
}

request.description: Booker = route petParentId (from JWT, not the body). Provider resolved from serviceId. petId must be yours. For PetGroomer set `serviceItemCode` (the duration is derived from it). `jobNotes` is optional free-text (access instructions, the pet's quirks) — captured here and returned on the booking detail. `locationType` is REQUIRED: 'ParentLocation' (provider comes to you) or 'ProviderLocation' (you go to the provider) — the booking detail resolves the matching address from it (400 InvalidRequest when missing, 400 UnsupportedLocationType when not one of the two). Captures `bookingId`. Errors: 404 PetNotFound / ServiceNotRegistered; 403 Forbidden; 400 InvalidServiceId / InvalidPetId / InvalidBookingTime; 409 ServiceClosed / CapacityExceeded / ProviderInactive.

The parent's own service bookings ("my bookings"), most-recent first (BookingDate/StartTime DESC), cancelled included. Ownership-filtered — petParentId comes from the JWT, so you only ever see your own. Returns [] when none (no 404).

Each card is sectioned: `booking` (the flat booking), `providerDetails` (businessName, imageUrl, city, serviceCategory, subCategory), `serviceDetails` (serviceId, serviceType, serviceItemCode, `pricePerHour`), `cancellationPolicy` and `location`.

SNAPSHOTS (2026-07-24): `serviceDetails.pricePerHour`, `cancellationPolicy.minimumHoursBeforeCancellation` (null | 24 | 48 | 72 | 96; null = no restriction) and `location` { locationType, addressLine, city, zipCode, latitude, longitude } are all read from values FROZEN onto the booking at creation — a later provider price/policy/address edit never changes an existing card. `location` is the SELECTED service location (the parent's address for ParentLocation, the provider's for ProviderLocation).

NOTE: unlike the booking-DETAIL read, this list does NOT live-resolve `location` — bookings created before the snapshot feature shipped return null address fields here (call GET .../bookings/{bookingId} for those).
Parent sets APPROVAL_NEEDED | COMPLETED | PARENT_CANCELLED on their own booking; audited. 403 Forbidden; 400 BookingStatusNotAllowed; 409 BookingStatusTerminal | BookingStatusUnchanged.
Full status audit trail, oldest-first. 404 if not your booking.

The provider's terms that changed since this booking was created (price, cancellation policy, selected-location address) plus rule-violation rows (fixed/minimum duration checked against the booked window). Always 200 → { bookingId, hasChanges, changes: [{ field, changeType (ValueChanged|RuleViolation), bookedValue, currentValue, message }] }; hasChanges: false means no confirmation sheet is needed. Feeds `acknowledgeTermsChanges` on POST .../modifications — proposing a change without it once terms have drifted returns 409 BookingTermsChanged. 404 BookingNotFound when the booking isn't yours.

Single booking read, sectioned: { bookingDetails, parentDetails, petDetails, providerDetails, paymentDetails, cancellationPolicy, location, startOtp, pendingModification, prescription }. `providerDetails` = { providerId, providerName, providerMobileCountryCode, providerMobile, providerGender, providerPhotoUrl (null for now), address, city, zip } — address/city/zip are the provider's registered BUSINESS address (Cosmos service doc), added so the client needn't call GET /providers/{id} just for the address; null when the offering can't be resolved. `parentDetails` also carries the parent's profile address (addressLine, city, zipCode, latitude, longitude). `petDetails` carries the FULL medical snapshot: breed, vaccinationStatus, vaccinationType, vaccinationDose, prescription, sterilizationStatus, medicalHistory, temperament (from the pet's profile). `location` = { locationType (ParentLocation | ProviderLocation | null), addressLine, city, zipCode, latitude, longitude } — the parent's address for ParentLocation, the provider's registered business address for ProviderLocation. `bookingDetails.serviceLocation` is populated for App bookings too (the provider offering's service-location, e.g. PetHotel / CustomerPlace / Both) and `bookingDetails.jobNotes` carries the notes captured at booking time. `cancellationPolicy` is a dedicated section { minimumHoursBeforeCancellation }. While the booking is START_JOB, startOtp carries the plaintext start-code + expiry for the parent to read to the provider (who enters it on the provider host's /start-job/verify); completion needs no OTP. pendingModification carries a staged proposed date/time. `prescription` = { prescriptionText, isPetVaccinated, vaccinations[], nextConsultationDate } — the vet's recorded prescription for a completed Vet job (this is what the app's 'View Prescription' page reads); NULL until the vet records one. 404 if not your booking.

SNAPSHOTS (2026-07-24): `paymentDetails.pricePerHour`, `cancellationPolicy.minimumHoursBeforeCancellation` and the `location` address are read from values FROZEN onto the booking at creation, so a later provider price/policy/address edit never changes an existing booking. Bookings created before this shipped fall back to live resolution. (The `parentDetails` / `providerDetails` CONTACT addresses are deliberately NOT frozen — they always show current contact info.)
Parent cancels their booking → PARENT_CANCELLED.

Parent reports the PROVIDER never showed up → PROVIDER_NO_SHOW (terminal, frees the slot). Allowed only from a confirmed-equivalent state and only 30+ minutes after the booking's scheduled start (bookingDate + startTime, UTC). 409 NoShowTooEarly before the grace window elapses; 409 BookingNotStartable from the wrong state (e.g. JOB_STARTED — the job already began).

Parent proposes a new date/time (editing is limited to the schedule). Stages the proposal → MODIFICATION_REQUEST_BY_PARENT; the provider sees it and accepts/declines. 409 ModificationAlreadyPending if one is already open.
Parent accepts the provider's staged modification → PARENT_ACCEPTED_MODIFICATION; the proposed date/time is applied and the staging row removed. 409 CapacityExceeded / NoPendingModification.
Parent declines the provider's staged modification → PARENT_DECLINED_MODIFICATION; booking keeps its original details, staging row removed.
Read-only: the provider-uploaded job-completion photos, oldest-first (parents view the proof; the provider uploads them).

The parent's review of the provider for a finished booking. `rating` 1..5; `comment` optional, max 1000 characters (blank/omitted stores nothing and reads back null). Reviewable = the booking is COMPLETED or PAID and is an App booking (not a Custom walk-in). **Upsert** — resubmitting replaces rating + comment on the same row, so a corrected star doesn't duplicate: 201 on the first review, 200 on an edit. createdAtUtc does NOT move on an edit (it's the date given, which is what the review list sorts on); updatedAtUtc does. The author is the route's petParentId (ownership-filtered, never from the body). Photos are attached separately below, since the blob path is keyed by the review id this call mints. 404 BookingNotFound; 403 Forbidden (not your booking); 409 BookingNotReviewable; 400 ReviewNotAppBooking (Custom walk-in) / InvalidRequest (rating out of range, comment too long). Night-stay twin: POST /pet-parents/{petParentId}/night-stay-bookings/{bookingId}/review.

The caller's own review of this booking, with its photos. 404 ReviewNotFound when they haven't written one yet — the booking detail's `review` section reports the same fact as a nullable field instead of a 404. Night-stay twin under /night-stay-bookings/.

multipart { file } — one photo per call, ≤3 MB, JPEG/PNG/WebP. Max 5 photos per review, enforced race-safely in SQL and pre-checked here so a caller at the cap isn't charged an upload first. Captures `bookingReviewPhotoId`. 404 ReviewNotFound ("submit your review before attaching photos" — the review must exist to own the blob path); 409 ReviewPhotoLimitReached; 400 InvalidFile / ImageTooLarge / UnsupportedImageFormat. Night-stay twin under /night-stay-bookings/.

Removes one photo (scoped by review + author) + best-effort blob delete. Returns { bookingReviewPhotoId, bookingReviewId, photoUrl, deletedAtUtc }. The review itself is NOT deletable — only its photos — so a rating is never stranded. 404 ReviewPhotoNotFound (unknown id, wrong review, and "not yours" are one case). Night-stay twin under /night-stay-bookings/.

item.name: 6b. Night-Stay Bookings (multi-night boarding)
item.description: Multi-night boarding (PetSitter NightStay service) is a separate entity from single-day bookings — a stay is a check-in/check-out date RANGE, not a single-day time window. The stay spans [checkInDate, checkOutDate): checkOutDate is the pickup day and is NOT a stayed night. Capacity is enforced per night. Parent-host only (the parent is who books). Provider/serviceId must come from a NightStay search (GET /providers/search/night-stay). The single-day POST /bookings rejects a NightStay serviceId with 400 UseNightStayEndpoint.

body.raw:
{
  "petId": "{{petId}}",
  "serviceId": "{{serviceId}}",
  "checkInDate": "2026-07-10",
  "checkOutDate": "2026-07-13",
  "jobNotes": "Bruno eats twice a day; medication in the side pocket.",
  "locationType": "ProviderLocation"
}

request.description: Books a multi-night stay. serviceId must be an active NightStay service; petId must be one of your pets; provider is resolved server-side. checkOutDate must be after checkInDate; max 30 nights; checkOutDate is the pickup day (not a stayed night). DropOff/PickUp times are snapshotted from the offering. `jobNotes` is optional free-text (feeding/medication instructions) — returned on the detail read. `locationType` is REQUIRED: 'ParentLocation' or 'ProviderLocation' (400 InvalidRequest when missing, 400 UnsupportedLocationType otherwise); the detail read resolves the matching address. Captures nightStayBookingId. Errors: 404 PetNotFound / 403 Forbidden (pet), 400 InvalidServiceId / NotNightStayService / OfferingNotConfigured / InvalidPetId / InvalidNightStayDates, 404 ProviderNotFound / PetParentNotFound, 409 ProviderInactive / CapacityExceeded / ServiceClosed.

Your own night-stay bookings, most-recent first (CheckInDate DESC), cancelled included. Ownership-filtered. [] when none.

Each card is sectioned: `booking`, `providerDetails` (businessName, imageUrl, city, serviceCategory, subCategory), `serviceDetails` (serviceId, serviceType, `pricePerNight`), `cancellationPolicy` and `location`.

SNAPSHOTS (2026-07-24): `serviceDetails.pricePerNight`, `cancellationPolicy.minimumHoursBeforeCancellation` (null | 24 | 48 | 72 | 96; null = no restriction) and `location` { locationType, addressLine, city, zipCode, latitude, longitude } are all read from values FROZEN onto the stay at creation — a later provider price/policy/address edit never changes an existing card. `location` is the SELECTED service location (the parent's address for ParentLocation, the provider's for ProviderLocation).

NOTE: unlike the night-stay DETAIL read, this list does NOT live-resolve `location` — stays created before the snapshot feature shipped return null address fields here (call GET .../night-stay-bookings/{bookingId} for those).

Single night-stay booking — sectioned to match the single-day booking detail: { bookingDetails (incl. jobId, checkIn/out, nights, dropOff/pickUp, serviceLocation, jobNotes), parentDetails (incl. the parent's address: addressLine, city, zipCode, latitude, longitude), petDetails (FULL medical snapshot: breed, vaccinationStatus, vaccinationType, vaccinationDose, prescription, sterilizationStatus, medicalHistory, temperament), providerDetails (providerId, providerName, mobile, gender, providerPhotoUrl (null), plus the provider's business address/city/zip from the Cosmos service doc — added so the client needn't call GET /providers/{id} just for the address), paymentDetails (pricePerNight, totalAmount, pawfrontFee), cancellationPolicy, location ({ locationType, addressLine, city, zipCode, latitude, longitude } — parent's address for ParentLocation, provider's for ProviderLocation), startOtp (while the stay is START_JOB — the start-code the parent reads to the provider), pendingModification (staged date-range proposal) }. 404 NightStayBookingNotFound if unknown or not yours.

SNAPSHOTS (2026-07-24): `paymentDetails.pricePerNight`, `cancellationPolicy.minimumHoursBeforeCancellation` and the `location` address are read from values FROZEN onto the stay at creation, so a later provider price/policy/address edit never changes an existing stay. Stays created before this shipped fall back to live resolution. (The `parentDetails` / `providerDetails` CONTACT addresses are deliberately NOT frozen.)

Parent moves the booking to a new status — one of APPROVAL_NEEDED | COMPLETED | PARENT_CANCELLED (cancel is done here, mirroring single-day; PARENT_CANCELLED frees the per-night capacity). Actor=Parent. 404 NightStayBookingNotFound, 403 Forbidden, 400 BookingStatusNotAllowed, 409 BookingStatusTerminal | BookingStatusUnchanged.
Full status audit trail, oldest-first. 404 if not your booking.

Night-stay twin of the single-day terms-changes read — drifted price, cancellation policy, drop-off/pick-up time, selected-location address, plus rule-violation rows (minimum nights). Always 200 → { bookingId, hasChanges, changes: [...] }. 404 NightStayBookingNotFound when the stay isn't yours.
Parent cancels the stay → PARENT_CANCELLED (frees per-night capacity).

Parent reports the PROVIDER never showed up for the stay → PROVIDER_NO_SHOW (terminal, frees the remaining per-night capacity). Allowed only from a confirmed-equivalent state and only 30+ minutes after checkInDate + dropOffTime (UTC). 409 NoShowTooEarly before the grace window elapses; 409 BookingNotStartable from the wrong state.
Parent proposes a new check-in/check-out range (checkOutDate = pickup day, NOT a stayed night) → MODIFICATION_REQUEST_BY_PARENT. 409 ModificationAlreadyPending if one is already open.

Parent accepts the provider's staged date-range proposal → PARENT_ACCEPTED_MODIFICATION; the range is applied (per-night capacity re-checked) and the staging row removed. 409 CapacityExceeded / NoPendingModification.
Parent declines the provider's staged proposal → PARENT_DECLINED_MODIFICATION; the stay keeps its original dates, staging row removed.
Read-only: the provider-uploaded job-completion photos for the stay, oldest-first.

Night-stay twin of the single-day review submit above — same rating (1..5) + optional 1000-char comment, same COMPLETED-or-PAID + App-booking gate, same upsert semantics (201 first time, 200 on an edit). 404 NightStayBookingNotFound; 403 Forbidden; 409 BookingNotReviewable; 400 ReviewNotAppBooking / InvalidRequest.
The caller's own review of this stay, with its photos. 404 ReviewNotFound when they haven't written one yet.

Night-stay twin of the single-day review-photo upload — same ≤3 MB / JPEG/PNG/WebP / 5-photo cap. Captures `nightStayBookingReviewPhotoId`. 404 ReviewNotFound; 409 ReviewPhotoLimitReached; 400 InvalidFile / ImageTooLarge / UnsupportedImageFormat.
Removes one photo (scoped by review + author) + best-effort blob delete. 404 ReviewPhotoNotFound (unknown id, wrong review, and "not yours" are one case).

item.name: 6c. Bookings Summary & History
item.description: Reporting surfaces over the parent's own bookings, both single-day and night-stay merged into ONE feed (a parent thinks "my bookings", not "my two kinds of bookings") — `bookingType` discriminates and the other kind's fields are null. Additive: the existing unpaginated GET /pet-parents/{id}/bookings and /night-stay-bookings above are unchanged.

query.description: Weekly|Monthly|Quarterly|Yearly|AllTime, default Monthly. Or use from/to/petId/status instead.

request.description: Counts + spend for the parent's bookings over a period. Returns { period, periodStart, periodEnd, totalBookings, singleDayBookings, nightStayBookings, completedBookings, upcomingBookings, cancelledBookings, paidBookings, awaitingPaymentBookings, unpricedBookings, amountSpent, upcomingAmount }. The three status buckets are mutually exclusive and sum to totalBookings — declines, no-shows and expiries all count as cancelled. `amountSpent` covers COMPLETED or PAID (the parent already handed over cash even if the provider hasn't tapped "mark paid"); `upcomingAmount` is what confirmed future bookings will cost and is deliberately NOT part of amountSpent. `status` accepts a comma-separated mix of the friendly groups Completed/Upcoming/Cancelled and raw lifecycle statuses. Same filters — and the identical WHERE clause — as /history below, so the two always describe the same set. 400 InvalidRequest (bad period/status, or from > to).

query.description: Date|Amount
capped at 20 server-side

request.description: Paginated history, single-day + night-stay merged. Unlike the provider earnings list this is NOT restricted to completed bookings — cancelled and upcoming ones belong in a history screen too, each carrying its expected `amount`. Explicit from/to override period. Sort defaults to Date/Desc with a BookingId tie-break. Rows carry jobId, status, serviceDate, providerId + providerName, pet name + photo, isCompleted, isPaid, amount, paidAtUtc, paymentMethod. The Pawfront commission is deliberately absent — the parent pays `amount` either way. 400 InvalidRequest.

query.description: AdoptionAndRescue | PetTraining | Charity | Volunteering | HealthAndWellness | SocialAndCultural | OutdoorActivities | ParentEducation
Physical | Online
Optional case-insensitive 'contains' search on the event title (LIKE %term%).

request.description: Catalog listing. All query params optional; amenities repeats. `title` is an optional case-insensitive 'contains' search on the event title. Captures the first event's `eventId`. Each event returns top-level `isPaid` / `price` (all event types), `pawPrints`, an `organizer { type, id, name, imageUrl }` block, physical details (incl. location), `eventLink` (online joining URL; null for physical), and a `bookings { maxBookings, totalBookings }` block (maxBookings = physical capacity, null for online; totalBookings = non-cancelled tickets booked).

query.description: Top-N (default 20, clamped 1..100).

request.description: Top-N trending events, most engaging first. Trending score = ViewCount + ShareCount + non-cancelled (Confirmed) ticket bookings. Same provider-agnostic shape + Cosmos hydration + isBookable (matched by JWT email) as GET /events; no filters. Mirror of the provider host.

Single event detail (SQL + Cosmos for physical). Returns top-level `isPaid` / `price` for every event type (online included), `physical.maximumCapacity` + `physical.location` for physical events, `eventLink` (online joining URL; null for physical), `pawPrints { viewCount, shareCount, inquiryCount }`, an `organizer { type, id, name, imageUrl, totalEventsOrganized }` block (totalEventsOrganized = how many events this organiser has created; populated on detail, null on list), a `bookings { maxBookings, totalBookings }` block, `paymentOptions ["Cash"|"Digital"]`, and `attendees [{ attendeeName, ticketNumber }]` (names only — booker contact / payment stay on the organiser dashboard).
Returns updated { viewCount, shareCount, inquiryCount }.

item.name: 8. Parent-organised Events
item.description: A pet parent can create their own events (ProviderId NULL, PetParentId set). Ownership-filtered on petParentId.

request.description: multipart/form-data → { url }. No 1 MB cap (banners can be larger). Captures the URL into `blobUrl` so you can paste it as bannerImageUrl below.

request.description: Creates a parent-organised event. `isPaid` / `price` are TOP-LEVEL (apply to all event types). `price` is required when `isPaid` is true. For Physical events, `physical.maximumCapacity` AND `physical.location` (houseNumber/street/city/zip/country required, lat/long optional) are required. Captures `eventId`. 404 PetParentNotFound; 400 InvalidRequest.

request.description: Full-replace edit of a parent-organised event — every field editable (same body shape as create). Ownership-filtered; 404 EventNotFound when not found or not owned by this parent; 400 InvalidRequest on validation. Reconciles the Cosmos physical doc (upsert when physical; deletes the old doc when the event becomes Online or its category changes). Editing a paid event to free drops its payout methods. Returns the full detail (incl. bookings, paymentOptions, attendees).

Partial edit — send ONLY the fields you want to change; everything else stays as-is. Each field is optional; an OMITTED field is left unchanged, while an explicit null CLEARS it (e.g. `"bannerImageUrl": null`). The merged event is then validated like a full edit, so cross-field rules still apply (flipping `eventType` to Physical needs a `physical` block; flipping `isPaid` to true needs a `price`). Ownership-filtered. 404 EventNotFound; 400 InvalidRequest. Returns the full detail (incl. bookings, paymentOptions, attendees).

Lists the events this parent has organised (mirror of the provider host's GET /providers/{providerId}/events). Ownership-filtered. Hydrates physical details (incl. location) per event. Each event includes pawPrints { viewCount, shareCount, inquiryCount }, an organizer { type, id, name, imageUrl } block, and a bookings { maxBookings, totalBookings } block (maxBookings = physical capacity, null for online; totalBookings = non-cancelled tickets booked). Ordered most-recent first; returns [] when the parent has organised none.

Sets how the organiser wants ticket proceeds paid out — one or more of Cash / Digital (replaces the previously saved set). **Only valid for PAID events** — a free event returns 400 FreeEventNoPayout. Uses the `eventId` captured by the Paid event create above. 404 EventNotFound; 400 InvalidRequest (empty list / unknown method).

item.name: 9. Event Ticket Bookings
item.description: Buy tickets for an event. Physical events accept any number of tickets (capacity-gated); online events accept exactly ONE ticket per booking (>1 attendee → 400 OnlineEventSingleTicket). One ticket row per attendee.

request.description: paymentMethod ∈ {CreditCard, Twint, Cash, Free}. One ticket row per attendee. Physical = any number of tickets; online = exactly one. Captures `eventBookingId`. 404 EventNotFound; 400 OnlineEventSingleTicket (>1 attendee on an online event); 409 EventSoldOut (physical capacity).
Booking + one entry per ticket (denormalised on the wire).

Soft-cancels the caller's own booking. Authorised by your Firebase **email claim** matched against the booking's bookerEmail (so you can only cancel a booking you made). Flips Status → Cancelled and frees the seat capacity automatically; returns the cancelled booking + tickets. 403 EmailClaimMissing (token has no email); 404 EventBookingNotFound (unknown id OR not yours); 409 EventBookingAlreadyCancelled.

Lists the caller's event-ticket bookings (slim cards joined with the event). Filters by the JWT email claim — 403 EmailClaimMissing if absent. Only matches bookings whose bookerEmail equals your Firebase email. Each card carries the event `eventType` + `eventLocation` (venue address for physical events; null for online), plus title, category, start date/time, and banner.

Streams the raw image bytes for a private-container blob URL (the response is binary — see Postman's Preview tab). Set `blobUrl` to a URL returned by any upload endpoint. 400 InvalidRequest (bad/foreign URL); 404 BlobNotFound.
